picks.excerpt: Indie horror auteur David Szymanski (Dusk, Iron Lung) says shipping generative-AI content in a game signals to players that the developer doesn't care, arguing craft and intent are the whole point of indie games.

Researchers used Age of Empires 2's scenario editor as a test bed to show how easily LLM-style AI fails at basic situated reasoning, arguing it is farcical to treat current AI systems as conscious or truly cognizant.

A data analyst crunched Steam data and found games carrying AI-content disclosures get roughly 53% fewer reviews, and the reviews they do get skew more negative — hard numbers for the commercial cost of shipping with AI on Steam.
